messages:
mira: FYI — saw a ~2.3x jump in hosted GPU hours for APAC last week vs our forecast. cloud-billing export attached. can someone sanity-check whether this is real traffic or a billing/invoice artifact?
ben: thanks mira. do you have the hourly breakdown? last time APAC spiked it was due to a misrouted batch job.
mira: pasted the bq query I'm using: 
```sql
SELECT region, DATE(hour) as d, SUM(gpu_hours) AS hours
FROM `redwood.billing.gpu_usage`
WHERE DATE(hour) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY region, d
ORDER BY d, region
```
kai: running now, should have results in 2m. quick skim shows surge centered on 2026-03-10 03:00-07:00 UTC, mostly p3 instances in ap-northeast-1.
ameer: ops-bot flagged a scaling event for the hosted pool at 03:05 UTC (autoscaler increased replicas x4). linking event: https://internal.redwood/tools/events/evt-9876
mira: here's the CSV head from billing export (sanitized):
```
region,gpu_type,hours,cost
ap-northeast-1,p3,124.5,1860
us-west-2,p3,51.0,765
eu-west-1,p3,47.3,710
```
katie_finance: looks like APAC alone added ~1.8k in spot-billed hours vs forecasted reserved utilization. Was any of that covered by our committed reservations?
ben: checking reservations matrix — our committed capacity is primarily in us-west-2 and eu-west-1; APAC has very little reserved. we did have a short-term promo cluster last month but that ended.
kai: hypothesis: some long-running hosted inference requests were routed to APAC due to earlier routing experiments. I found a canary config flagged on 2026-03-09 that preferred ap-northeast-1 for low-latency traffic: `routing.policy=prefer-region(ap-northeast-1)`
mira: that config was supposed to be canaryed to 1% traffic. logs show it was applied to the global routing service with a rollout flag mistake — 100% for 4 hours.
ameer: ops-bot log: `rollout.apply(config=route-prefer-ap, from=1, to=100, user=kai)` at 2026-03-09T22:58:03Z. seems like operator error.
kai: ugh my bad — I mis-clicked when copying flags. sorry everyone. immediate mitigations: revert the routing policy to default and request transient burst capacity from cloud to avoid throttling while we rebalance.
ben: action items: 1) revert routing (kai) 2) open cloud support ticket to credit obvious billing spike and request temporary cap increase for hosted pool (mira) 3) run cost reforecast for committed vs on-demand for next 3 months (katie_finance + eng-infra) 4) add guardrail to rollout UI to prevent >5% accidental rollouts (eng-infra + eng-platform).
katie_finance: for the reforecast I'll need daily granularity for the last 90 days plus the committed reservation SKUs and their term/coverage. can someone drop the reservation CSV into /shared/finance/apac-reservation.csv?
mira: uploaded current reservation export here: https://internal.redwood/s3/exports/apac-reservation.csv
ben: opening the cloud support ticket now — ticket #CLOUD-21042. linking the invoice snapshot and asking for billing adjustment for the 4-hour window.
ami-bot: CLOUD-21042: Support ticket created. Estimated response 24-48h.
ameer: monitoring note — cluster health looks okay but KV cache fills spiked; we saw higher tail latency around 03:10 UTC. recorded in observability: https://internal.redwood/observability/spans/trace-5512
kai: reverted routing at 2026-03-10T05:12:11Z. verifying traffic is back to normal. will run a small canary for 1% later with automated rollback.
mira: thanks. for the reforecast, recommend two scenarios: (A) shift some reserved commitment to APAC (Q2-commit window) vs (B) implement stricter regional routing and use dedicated burst credits. both have different cost profiles — let's table numbers in the reforecast doc.
katie_finance: I'll produce a 3-tier reforecast (no change / partial reserve / full reserve) by EOD Thursday.
ben: nicely scoped. let's also add a postmortem blurb to the infra changelog and tag this as a process failure (rollout guardrail missing).
ai-ops-bot: New postmortem draft created: /changelog/infra/2026-03-10-apac-routing-spike.md
mira: cool. closing loop — will follow up in the reforecast thread once katie and ben have numbers. thanks all :thumbsup:
